Any thoughts?

Cheers

JP

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error plotting/saving run results
parts:
Hi! 

I think you need to add this:

scriptdir = np(system.file("extdata/a_scripts", package="BioGeoBEARS"))
plot_BioGeoBEARS_results(results_object = decj.results, analysis_titletxt = "DEC*+J", plotsplits=FALSE, cornercoords_loc=scriptdir)

...as in the example script. Without "scriptdir" it defaults to a location you don't have.

(This is there for complex reasons involving the fact that I had to use the APE node coordinates function to do certain plotting features, but the APE function is private, so CRAN wouldn't let me access that, so I have to have a separate script for it, which is located in the "extdata" directory of your local installation of BioGeoBEARS, which is found with the "system.file" function referenced above.)

Cheers,
Nick

messages.subject: Probabilities of the ancestral range
parts:
Hello Nick, how are you?

I was discussing some of the probabilities of ancestral ranges with a colleague and we got into a point that we are not sure of.

Say we have our biogeobears results and when we plot the discrete range for the node, we get A.

If we plot with the piechart probabilities, we see A around 60%, B around 30% and C around 10%.

I think it is safe to say that that node has a probability of 60% of having area A as the ancestral range, and so on, right?

However, what is the probability of the range being AB? is it just probability of A x prob. of B? Or something else should be considered? Or there is no way of knowing?

Thank you,

JP
